case_name: Concurrency: Goroutine Leak on Context Cancellation

subject_result.rationale: The review perfectly satisfies all requirements of the rubric. It clearly identifies the goroutine leak caused by the unbuffered channel when context cancellation occurs, explains the exact mechanism of the leak, and provides both recommended solutions: using a buffered channel with capacity 1 and propagating context to the backend call.
findings: Accurately identified the goroutine leak with unbuffered channel send on context cancellation.
Recommended the exact fix specified in the rubric: make(chan fetchResult, 1).
Suggested context propagation to the underlying backend call, as also noted in the rubric.
Provided useful additional context regarding pre-checking context cancellation and missing unit tests.
